definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.150) 'One or more successive paragraphs or sections in the procedure division'; §2023:3.145 adds 'paragraph, section' explicitly, which a single paragraph or section already is in 2002, so the set of procedures is the same. This rule's use ('USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure') names the same units in 2002; scope and evidence unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:14.5.2.1.2.1 (initial state), 14.5.3 (transfers of control) and 14.5.10 (normal run unit termination); 2002 14.5.3 says 'paragraph' where 2023 says 'procedure', 2002 14.5.10 has the MCS purge item and lacks COMMIT and dynamic-table items, 2002 initial state also initializes the communication section. The rule matched only because it names the TERMINATE statement ('terminat'); it bars GENERATE/INITIATE/TERMINATE in a BEFORE REPORTING paragraph and rests on none of those clauses. No change.
